{{Quote|Don't stand there. That spot is reserved exclusively for my gundark friends. You are clearly not a gundark. Your ears are too small.|Trymbo|audio=Trymbo-Gundark-TOR.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Trymbo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] living in [[Oradam village]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] who perfected a chemical compound that supercharged artillery cannons. The chemicals were highly unstable, and the process of transporting them to their buyers was referred to by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] as the "Big Boom Run."

Trymbo was psychologically unstable, possibly suffering from [[Hallucination/Legends|hallucinations]], and rambled about things that apparently only he could see. He was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to a Human female named [[Loonda]].
